name: Applied Solid Mechanics
description: Stress and strain tensors; governing equations; Hooke’s law; failure criteria. Thin-walled structures; bending without twist; pure twisting in open and closed sections; combined torsion and bending, warping, shear stresses in non-symmetric sections; section property calculations; composite sections; shear lag. Plate bending: governing equations, analytical solutions, isotropic and anisotropic plates, circular plates. Cylindrical shells: governing equations, membrane theory. Buckling and ultimate strength: columns, plates, cylindrical shells, stiffened panels, failure criteria. Tutorial activities: problem-solving on stress and strain tensors, thin-walled structures, plate and shell bending, and buckling with applications in design of marine structures.
